garbage.notes: 1 bin per address. No construction materials, recyclables, or organics. Place bin at curb by 7am.

recycling.notes: Containers, packaging, and printed materials only. No plastic bags, Styrofoam, or electronics.

organics.notes: Food scraps, yard waste, and soiled paper/cardboard. No plastic or compostable bags — use paper bags or place loose. Winter: biweekly (Dec–Apr).

bulky.notes: Furniture, mattresses, BBQs, and non-refrigerant appliances. No construction debris, electronics, or branches. Fridge/freezer: free pickup by appointment via GoRecycle.

leaves.notes: Spring (May) and fall (Oct–Nov) fixed-date collection windows. Paper bags or labelled bins only — no plastic bags. Branches up to 2.5 cm diameter, tied in bundles (max 1 m × 30 cm). No ash branches Mar–Sep.

christmas_tree.notes: Single annual collection. Remove all decorations — no artificial snow. Place at curb 48h before collection.
